Message to U.S. Citizens: Demonstration Alert: May 1 Protests in Metro Manila

https://t.co/wxEQnBX5Jm

Location: Metro Manila

Event: Several demonstrations are expected in Metro Manila on Friday, May 1, 2026. Local authorities expect around 8,000 protesters from various organizations at several locations, including the U.S. embassy. The embassy is scheduled to be closed May 1 for
 Philippine Labor Day.

Locations include:
•Manila– España Boulevard, Mendiola, Liwasang Bonifacio, and the U.S. embassy
•Quezon City– the Welcome Rotonda, University of Santo Tomas, St. Joseph’s College, and the University of the Philippines
•Other locations in the National Capital Region

Actions to Take: 

•U.S. citizens should avoid political demonstrations. Foreign nationals found engaging in a protest could be considered in violation of their immigration status.

•Exercise caution when in the vicinity of any large gatherings, as even peaceful demonstrations have the potential to turn violent without warning. Follow instructions from local authorities.

•Follow local media and government sources for updates on possible public demonstrations, including information on disruptions to traffic or public services.
Enroll in the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (https://t.co/q8w0nZfWZo) to receive Alerts and make it easier to locate you in an emergency.

—————————————————
For further information and assistance:

•Enroll in the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (https://t.co/q8w0nZfWZo) to receive Alerts and make it easier to locate you in an emergency.

•Contact the U.S. Embassy in Manila, Philippines, located at 1201 Roxas Boulevard, at +(63) (2) 5301-2000, from 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Monday through Friday. After-hours emergency number for U.S. citizens is +(63) (2) 5301-2000.

•Call 1-888-407-4747 toll-free in the United States and Canada or 1-202-501-4444 from other countries from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Eastern Standard Time, Monday through Friday (except U.S. federal holidays).

•See the State Department’s travel website (https://t.co/Tiyt8sq7F9) for the Worldwide Caution, Travel Advisories, Alerts, and the Philippines Country Specific Information. (https://t.co/8TZK4SKGSF).

Matagumpay na isinagawa ang 1st General Assembly at Capacity Building Training ng 142 Punong Barangay ng Lungsod Quezon para sa taong 2026  mula Abril 27 hanggang 29 sa Hive Hotel & Convention Place..

Pinangunahan ito ng Liga ng mga Barangay – Quezon City Chapter sa ilalim ng pamumuno ni Liga President Hon. Jose Maria "Mari" M. Rodriguez.

Nagbigay suporta  sa pagtitipon ang panauhing pandangal na si Senadora Imee R. Marcos.

Sa loob ng tatlong araw, tinalakay ang mahahalagang paksa mula sa iba-ibang ahensya at sektor:

DAY 1 SPEAKERS

• Atty. Orlando Paolo Casimiro - Manager, Legal Services Department, MWSS
• Christian Nicole B. Baluca, Ph.D. - Manager, Policy, Planning and Public Relations Department, MWSS
• Engr. Silver James E. Almazan - Head, Relationship Management Maynilad - Key Account Relations, Maynilad Water Services Inc.
• Engr. Michael D. Andres - Supervisor, Technical Management Maynilad - Key Account Relations, Maynilad Water Services Inc.
• Engr. Roylan Swanson – Quezon City Engineering Department
• Engr. Jonathan Espino – Quezon City Engineering Department
• FSSupt. Roberto D. Samillano Jr. - District Fire Marshal, Quezon City Fire District - BFP
• FSSupt. Froilan B. Guzman - Deputy District Fire Marshal, Quezon City Fire District - BFP

DAY 2 SPEAKERS

• Raymond Almonte - Deputy City Prosecutor, Office of the City Prosecutor - Quezon City
• Alexis Bartolome - Senior Assistant City Prosecutor, Office of the City Prosecutor - Quezon City
• Ma. Florina G. Cureg - Dangerous Drugs Board
• Beltran T. Lacap Jr. - Investigation Agent V, District Officer, PDEA QCDO
• Randy Glenn G. Silvio - District Director, Quezon City Police District
• Pol. Col. Robert D. Lingbawan – Quezon City Police District
• PMaj. Elvin S. Ballesteros – OIC, DDEU, Quezon City Police District
• Pol. Capt. Roberto Awid, Jr. – Quezon City Police District
• Kristine Pascua - Quezon City Anti-Drug Abuse Advisory Council
• Ma. Margarita S. Mejia, DPA - Head, Business Permits and Licensing Department
• Joel Distrajo - OIC, Quezon City Citizen Services Department
• Ricky Corpuz - Head, Barangay and Community Relations Department

DAY 3 SPEAKER

• Atty. John Thomas S. Alferos III - Head, Office of the Secretary to the Sangguniang Panlungsod

Patunay ang aktibidad na ito sa patuloy na pagpapalakas ng kakayahan ng ating mga lider-barangay tungo sa mas maayos, ligtas, at maunlad na mga komunidad sa Lungsod Quezon.
